EC1: - Suffering from pain in the day of assessment.
EC5: - History of Whiplash [OR] or Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) in the last year.
EC6: - History of Stroke (CVA), Multiple Sclerosis (MS) [OR] or Central Positional Vertigo.
EC7: - Coronary Heart Disease (CHD), Cardiac Heart Failure (CHF), Cardiac arrhythmias, [OR] Vertebrobasilar Insufficiency (VBI).
EC10: - Vestibular Migraine, [OR] Vestibular Neuritis, [OR] Menier's Disease, [OR] Perilymphatic Fistula, [OR] Superior Canal Dehiscence Syndrome.
EC11: - Medical conditions with high risk of subluxation [OR] / dislocation of the Atlanto-axial joint.
EC12: - Health professionals who are specialized to treat Vestibular disorders (such as Vestibular physiotherapists)
